newsitem.title: HONG KONG: DKB unit Chekiang First Bk mandates FRCD.
newsitem.headline: DKB unit Chekiang First Bk mandates FRCD.

text.p: Chekiang First Bank, a wholly owned subsidiary of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd, has mandated three banks to arrange a HK$500 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue, arranger Schroders Asia said on Monday.
The certificates will carry a maturity of five years with put and call options in years three and four.
The other arrangers are DKB Asia and Commerz (East Asia).
General syndication is expected this week.
The all-in return is reported to be around 65 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
